title: OL-20261115-24: Actions run logs are an unmeasured publication surface
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** daily lane sweep and any change to doctrine/publication.json
**Done check:** nogrep:doctrine/publication.json::actions-run-logs
**Status:** open

Run logs of workers, license, spec, seed and ops become public when the repo does. `publication --audit --org` does not read them; the policy lists them under `unmeasured_surfaces`. Close by adding a log scan (or a recorded deletion of logs older than the flip) to foundation/publication.py and removing the entry.
